name: Joined-hemisphere throwing
summary: Two large bowls are thrown on the wheel and joined at the rim when leather-hard. The seam is smoothed, and the sphere closes at the top with a collar.
how: Throw two bowls of the same width on the wheel.
Dry both until they are leather-hard.
Join the rims with slip and smooth the seam inside and outside.
Add a neck and a foot ring, then glaze and fire.

origin.note: Joseon potters throw large round jars in two halves and join them.

adoptions.via: Joseon potters make the large white moon jar in two bowls joined at the belly.
